steps.title: Crank: revolve the disc and shaft
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as crank.ipt.

Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw half the profile above the X axis: the disc 55 diameter and 11 thick, the shaft 15 diameter to 31 from the back face, a taper to 12.2 at 43.5 and a 1.0 chamfer to 9.7 at 44.5 (overall length 44.5).
Finish Sketch. Revolve: Profile = the half profile, Axis = the X axis, Full. OK.

steps.title: Crank: round the rim
actions: Fillet: radius 1.5 (R1.5 TYP.), select the two rim edges of the 55 disc. OK.

steps.title: Crank: crescent recess (counterweight)
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the back face. Draw a circle R24 and a circle 23.5 diameter, both centred 15.8 below the axis (the crank pin centre).
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the ring between the two circles, Cut, Distance 5.5. OK.
Fillet R1.5 round the bottom of the recess. The full-thickness crescent left at the top is the counterweight.

steps.title: Crank: pin hole and centre hole
actions: Hole: Placement = Concentric with the 23.5 boss, Simple Hole, diameter 11, Termination Through All.
Hole: Placement = on the axis of the shaft end, Simple Hole, diameter 4, Through All (it runs the whole length, see section A-A).

steps.title: Crank: detail B face step
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the front face of the disc (shaft side). Draw circles 40 and 20.5 diameter on the axis.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the ring between them, Cut, Distance 0.2 (detail B at 2:1).

steps.title: Crank: key slot under the shaft
actions: Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw a circle R6.6 with its centre 6.8 from the shaft end and 11.1 below the axis.
Finish Sketch. Extrude: Profile = the circle inside the shaft, Cut, Symmetric, Distance 1.8 (the 1.8 slot in the end view). Save.
steps.note: The sheet gives the R6.6 cutter position (6.8 and 11.1) and the slot width (1.8). It is a seat for a small key that drives whatever fits on the taper.
